claims.text: sleep-lifelog-2024 is a multimodal smartphone, smartwatch, sleep-sensor, and self-report dataset of about 700 days recorded in 2024 with seven prediction targets (Q1, Q2, Q3, S1, S2, S3, S4). The released training labels are in ch2026_metrics_train.csv and produce a 450-row modeling table grouped by subject_id.

The local canonical evaluation split for sprint 1 is GroupKFold by subject_id with 3 folds on the released training labels. Some older docs framed only six targets; the released package takes precedence over those older notes.
Q-family labels are participant-relative averages and therefore at very high leakage risk under same-subject splits; objective S-family labels reflect guideline compliance.

summary: First-class definition of the sleep-lifelog-2024 dataset used by the team. Lists released package contents, sensor modalities, the locally locked GroupKFold-by-subject split policy, and known leakage risks. No metric claim is made.
title: Sleep Lifelog 2024 Dataset Definition
